phrase.en: Could you recommend a local dish?

text.ru: recommend + существительное: recommend a dish. «Советую попробовать» — I recommend trying…, а не recommend to try. Русское «мне» здесь не нужно: Could you recommend…?
text.en: recommend + noun: recommend a dish. “I suggest you try” is I recommend trying…, not recommend to try.
text.es: recommend + sustantivo: recommend a dish. «Te recomiendo probar» — I recommend trying…, no recommend to try.

examples.en: We only eat local food on holiday.
examples.ru: В отпуске мы едим только местную еду.

exercises.en: I recommend trying the local wine.
